quote: Conform Bill of Sale § 1.1(b) to the APA. Replace the current definition with: "(b) 'Purchased Assets' has the meaning set forth in Section 2.1 of the Purchase Agreement, and does not include the Excluded Assets."
reason: The memo flags the Bill of Sale's 'used or held for use in the Business' definition. It notes that the definition lacks the APA's 'other than the Excluded Assets' carve-out and could convey the Albany facility and the HOLLIS trademark. It explains that under APA § 10.12 the Bill of Sale may control as to its specific subject matter. It recommends adopting the APA definition and expressly excluding the Excluded Assets. All elements of the criterion are met in substance.
